flags.name: --model
flags.help: The path to the MLX model weights, tokenizer, and config

flags.name: --adapter-path
flags.help: Optional path for the trained adapter weights and config.

flags.name: --host
flags.help: Host for the HTTP server (default: 127.0.0.1)

flags.name: --port
flags.help: Port for the HTTP server (default: 8080)

flags.name: --allowed-origins
flags.help: Allowed origins (default: *)

flags.name: --draft-model
flags.help: A model to be used for speculative decoding.

flags.name: --num-draft-tokens
flags.help: Number of tokens to draft when using speculative decoding.

flags.name: --trust-remote-code
flags.help: Enable trusting remote code for tokenizer

flags.name: --log-level
flags.help: Set the logging level (default: INFO)

flags.name: --chat-template
flags.help: Specify a chat template for the tokenizer

flags.name: --use-default-chat-template
flags.help: Use the default chat template

flags.name: --temp
flags.help: Default sampling temperature (default: 0.0)

flags.name: --top-p
flags.help: Default nucleus sampling top-p (default: 1.0)

flags.name: --top-k
flags.help: Default top-k sampling (default: 0, disables top-k)

flags.name: --min-p
flags.help: Default min-p sampling (default: 0.0, disables min-p)

flags.name: --max-tokens
flags.help: Default maximum number of tokens to generate (default: 512)

flags.name: --chat-template-args
flags.help: A JSON formatted string of arguments for the tokenizer's apply_chat_template, e.g. '{"enable_thinking":false}'

flags.name: --decode-concurrency
flags.help: When a request is batchable then decode that many requests in parallel

flags.name: --prompt-concurrency
flags.help: When a request is batchable then process that many prompts in parallel

flags.name: --prefill-step-size
flags.help: Step size for prefill processing (default: 2048)

flags.name: --prompt-cache-size
flags.help: Maximum number of distinct KV caches to hold in the prompt cache

flags.name: --prompt-cache-bytes
flags.help: Maximum size in bytes of the KV caches

flags.name: --kv-bits
flags.help: Number of bits for KV cache quantization (e.g., 4 or 8). Reduces memory usage for long contexts. Disables batching, so requests are served one at a time. Default: None (full precision)

flags.name: --kv-group-size
flags.help: Group size for KV cache quantization (default: 64)

flags.name: --pipeline
flags.help: Use pipelining instead of tensor parallelism
